items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, yeah. My goodness, Bach swings.

ctx.x: When you mention the klezmer band, and the way they swung – we have an interview with Ellington in 1939 in Sweden where the Swedish guy is trying to get him to say that jazz is the only music that swings. Ellington says – he said, “Swing is an emotional element.” He said, “All music swings in . . .”
Oh, yeah. My goodness, Bach swings.
Yeah, especially when Glen Gould plays it.
